Description: Email/password registration and login with JWT
What_Is_Implemented: Go backend auth endpoints; bcrypt password hashing; JWT generation + validation; localStorage token persistence
What_Is_Missing: Refresh token rotation; password reset flow (out of scope)

Description: Enterprise SSO integration (LDAP / Active Directory / Okta)
What_Is_Implemented: Nothing
What_Is_Missing: Entire SSO layer: LDAP bind, OAuth2/OIDC provider, Okta SDK

Description: User profile with configurable preferences (language / result count / reranker toggle)
What_Is_Implemented: User entity exists (id, email, name) in DB
What_Is_Missing: Preferences table; language / page-size / reranker settings; preferences UI panel

Description: Persistent conversation history stored per authenticated user
What_Is_Implemented: PostgreSQL search history (per user via JWT); Redis chat sessions (7-day TTL keyed by query slug); full CRUD API
What_Is_Missing: Full multi-turn session re-open (load entire past conversation); per-user session index listing

Description: History panel with search / filter by date / delete / re-open past sessions
What_Is_Implemented: HistoryContext with fetch/add/deleteAll/deleteSingle; basic history list in UI
What_Is_Missing: Filter-by-date UI; keyword search in history; re-open session (restore all messages into ChatWidget)

Description: Session management with configurable TTL / timeout
What_Is_Implemented: JWT has expiry; Redis chat sessions have hardcoded 7-day TTL
What_Is_Missing: Configurable TTL per user or admin; session timeout UI in settings

Description: Dual-panel layout: left = ranked doc list, right = AI conversation panel
What_Is_Implemented: Results page with search results + AISummary + People Also Ask sidebar + Research Workspace drawer; 3-column on XL
What_Is_Missing: True side-by-side 2-column layout (AI is floating widget not docked panel); follow-up suggestion chips not displayed

Description: Query submission triggers hybrid retrieval (Stage 1 BM25+HNSW + Stage 2 reranker)
What_Is_Implemented: Full pipeline: BM25 inverted index + CLIP HNSW vector search → true RRF fusion → multimodal LTR reranker; stage timings returned
What_Is_Missing: Nothing

Description: Doc list shows Top-K results with title, source, snippet, relevance badge, thumbnail
What_Is_Implemented: Title, URL, snippet, relevance score badge (green/yellow/red), rank delta badge, images (up to 4 thumbnails); injected into LLM on first turn
What_Is_Missing: Chunk-level granularity (whole docs indexed not chunks); content type badge; last modified date; chunk ID per result

Description: AI panel streams LLM response with inline citations and follow-up support
What_Is_Implemented: AISummary with markdown rendering; ChatWidget with multi-turn sessions and markdown; query rewriting integrated
What_Is_Missing: Streaming responses (SSE); structured citation links from AI text to specific result cards

Description: Follow-up questions maintain session state; query rewriter converts to standalone queries, updates doc list
What_Is_Implemented: refine_search_query() in llm_service.py working; ChatWidget sends refined query back to Results page via navigate()
What_Is_Missing: Doc panel does not auto-refresh when follow-up is submitted from chat; no seamless round-trip loop updating results

Description: Automated ingestion from Confluence, Google Drive, Git repos, local network shares
What_Is_Implemented: Web crawler (DrissionPage-based) crawls public URLs and indexes HTML content + images
What_Is_Missing: Confluence REST API connector; Google Drive API connector; Git repo parser; network share (SMB/NFS) reader

Description: Document chunking by paragraph, heading, or fixed token count
What_Is_Implemented: Nothing
What_Is_Missing: Entire chunking pipeline: paragraph splitter, heading-based chunker, sliding-window token chunker; chunk table in DB; chunk IDs and offsets

Description: Configurable index refresh: real-time incremental or scheduled batch
What_Is_Implemented: Admin panel has manual re-index trigger; index_service can index individual docs on demand
What_Is_Missing: Incremental update (only new/changed docs); scheduled batch with cron expression; refresh policy config UI

What_Is_Implemented: SQL-based posting lists (terms + postings + doc_stats tables); BM25 scoring with TF-IDF weighting; BM25Calculator service

What_Is_Implemented: CLIP-ViT-B-32 (512-dim) via sentence-transformers; pgvector HNSW cosine index; separate image_embeddings table; GPU acceleration (RTX 2080 Ti)

What_Is_Implemented: BM25Calculator with TF-IDF weighting; posting list lookup; top-K configurable via settings; tokenised query preprocessing

Description: Dense vector retrieval (HNSW) with configurable Top-N
What_Is_Implemented: CLIP text→vector encoding; pgvector cosine similarity ANN search; configurable top-K

Description: RRF fusion of BM25 and vector scores
What_Is_Implemented: True Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60); parallel BM25+vector execution; merged ranked list as Stage 1 output

Description: Retrieved chunks include metadata: source / page / chunk ID / modified date / content type / relevance score
What_Is_Implemented: Title, source URL, snippet (~200 chars), relevance score, rank delta; stage timings; image thumbnails

Description: Metadata pre-filtering: date range, source type, domain, content type
What_Is_Implemented: SearchRequest model accepts a filters field

Description: Retrieval API exposes per-stage scores for debugging (visible in admin panel)

Description: Top-K chunks formatted and injected into LLM user message
What_Is_Implemented: First chat turn carries all search context: numbered text snippets + up to 4 labeled inline images (base64); subsequent turns reuse history
What_Is_Missing: Nothing

Description: Grounded generation only — LLM answers strictly from provided context
